# Sandro Mikautadze

> AI researcher working on the mechanistic interpretability of medical vision-language models. Research intern at Doctolib (Paris). MSc in AI and Advanced Visual Computing, École Polytechnique; BSc in Mathematical and Computing Sciences for AI, Bocconi.
